| [Workflow hardening is deferred](goals.md#problem-flow-deferred-workflow-questions) | Vendoring Foldkit as a subtree, requiring human approval, signed commits and Renovate are all deferred. | [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:112-113][133], [log L118][13] | Decide each item or record that it stays deferred. | decided |
| [The module-mocking lint rule has a gap](goals.md#problem-flow-lint-mocking-gap) | The lint rule that forbids module mocking matches only the `vitest` import source, so a mock imported from `vite-plus/test` passes. | [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:142][134], [foldkit-flow:tools/oxlint/anti-slop/rules/no-module-mocking.ts:42-43][135], [issue foldkit-flow#5][136], [log L118][13] | Make the anti-slop module-mocking rule match the `vite-plus/test` source too. | decided |
| [No security, conduct or contributing files](goals.md#problem-flow-community-files) | The public repository has no SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. The README has a short contributing section. | [absent foldkit-flow:SECURITY.md][117], [absent foldkit-flow:CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md][117], [absent foldkit-flow:CONTRIBUTING.md][117], [foldkit-flow:README.md:98-100][137], [log L118][13] | Add the three files before the first publish. | decided |
